name: Ink bleed
description: Runs the frame like wet ink on paper: colour is dragged down capillary veins, pools against the drying front, and creeps a little further every frame. The wet patches drift, so nothing stays soaked for long.

bleed.description: How far colour is dragged along a run.

wet.description: How much of the frame is soaked at once.

drip.description: Frame-to-frame creep — this is the part that accumulates.

stain.description: Darkening and tint where the ink pools against the front.
